_about: Tribal allotment territories for Joshua 13-21. Polygons are APPROXIMATE bounding shapes only — they do NOT trace the boundary descriptions in the biblical text city-by-city. They are anchored on already-gazetted boundary cities and the directional logic of the chapter ('from Aroer ... to Heshbon ... the Jordan as the western border'). Replace with sourced or text-traced GeoJSON before treating as final. Each feature has properties.tribe (slug, matches chapter JSON tribes[] field), properties.name (display name), properties.approximate (true means placeholder), and properties.source_chapter (where the boundary is described).

properties.name: Judah
properties.note: Text-traced from the boundary description of Joshua 15: north line via Beth Hoglah, the ascent of Adummim, En Shemesh, the Valley of Hinnom, Kiriath Jearim, Chesalon, Beth Shemesh, Timnah, Ekron, Jabneel; west line along the Mediterranean to the Brook of Egypt (Wadi El-Arish); south line via Azmon, Kadesh Barnea, the Wilderness of Zin, Akrabbim, to the southern bay of the Dead Sea; east line up the western shore of the Dead Sea. Vertices interpolate the unidentified waypoints (Stone of Bohan, Mount Ephron, Mount Seir, Shikkeron, Mount Baalah). approximate=true because of the interpolation and because the actual boundary has more zigzag than these vertices represent.

properties.name: Reuben
properties.note: Trans-Jordan plateau (the Mishor) from the Arnon north to Heshbon. Anchor cities: Aroer on the Arnon (south rim), Dibon, Heshbon (north), Beth-Jeshimoth and the slopes of Pisgah (west, above the Dead Sea). West border is the Jordan and the Dead Sea east shore.

properties.name: Gad
properties.note: Half of Gilead and the Jordan valley north of Reuben to the south end of the Sea of Chinnereth. Anchor cities: Jazer, Mahanaim, Ramath Mizpeh; valley cities Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, Zaphon. West border is the Jordan; eastern border vague ('half the land of the Ammonites').

properties.name: Ephraim
properties.note: Text-traced from the Ephraim border description: south line via Bethel, Ataroth-Addar, Lower Beth-Horon, Gezer, to the Mediterranean; north line via the Brook of Kanah (Wadi Qana), Tappuah, Michmethath, Taanath-Shiloh, Janoah, Naarah, to the Jordan; east line along the Jordan; west line along the Mediterranean. approximate=true because Michmethath is interpolated and the Brook-of-Kanah western reach is generalized.

properties.name: Half-Manasseh (West)
properties.note: Central hill country between Ephraim (south, the Brook of Kanah / Wadi Qana) and Asher / Issachar (north, roughly the Jezreel-valley line). Western boundary at the Mediterranean; eastern boundary along the southern Issachar fringe (NOT the Jordan — Manasseh-West does not reach the Jordan in this chapter, though the enclave cities at Beth-Shean lie within Issachar). The 'three heights' enclaves of v. 11 (Beth-Shean, Ibleam, Dor, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo) lie outside this polygon, in adjacent tribes. approximate=true; the boundary description is impressionistic, especially northward.

properties.name: Benjamin
properties.note: A narrow east-west strip in the central hill country, north of Judah and south of Ephraim. North line: Jordan at Jericho westward through the wilderness of Beth-Aven to Bethel/Luz, Ataroth-Addar, Lower Beth-Horon. West line: south to Kiriath-Jearim. South line: Kiriath-Jearim eastward via Nephtoah, the Valley of Hinnom (south of Jerusalem), En-Rogel, En-Shemesh, Geliloth (Adummim ridge), the Stone of Bohan, Beth Hoglah, to the north bay of the Dead Sea. East line: Jordan.

properties.name: Simeon
properties.note: Embedded in the southern part of Judah's allotment ('out of the part of Judah', v. 9). Anchored on Beersheba, Moladah, Hormah, Ziklag, and Sharuhen. Most Simeonite town locations are uncertain; the polygon is a notional Negev block around Beersheba.

properties.name: Zebulun
properties.note: Central Galilee, between the Jezreel valley (south) and the Beit Netofa valley / Iphtah-El (north). Anchor cities: Sarid, Bethlehem-Zebulun, Nahalal, Hannathon, Shimron, Chisloth-Tabor. The northeastern boundary at Mount Tabor is shared with Issachar and Naphtali.

properties.name: Issachar
properties.note: Eastern Lower Galilee: the Jezreel valley plus the Hill of Moreh and the slopes down to the Jordan. Anchor cities: Jezreel (Tel Yizreel), Shunem, Mount Tabor (the northern boundary point with Zebulun and Naphtali), En-Gannim (Jenin).

properties.name: Asher
properties.note: Coastal strip from the Carmel headland north past Acco to the Phoenician cities (Sidon, Tyre). Anchor cities: Achshaph, Helkath, Mount Carmel (south boundary), Aphek-of-Asher near Acco, Kanah, Tyre. Asher's actual reach to Sidon and Tyre is aspirational; v. 28-29 ('even to great Sidon ... to the fortified city of Tyre') marks the ideal northern frontier rather than effective control.

properties.name: Naphtali
properties.note: Eastern Galilee: from the Sea of Galilee and the Jordan upper waters north into the upper Galilee hills and the Hula basin. Anchor cities: Hazor, Kedesh-Naphtali, Chinnereth (the town), Hammath, Ramah-Naphtali. The eastern boundary follows the Jordan and the Sea of Galilee.

properties.name: Dan
properties.note: Coastal plain and inner Shephelah south of Joseph and west of Benjamin: Aijalon valley, Ekron, Joppa, Bene-Berak. The conquest of Leshem (Tel Dan, v. 47) on the far north is a separate enclave, not represented in this polygon. Dan's southern boundary runs roughly along the latitude of Ekron-Eshtaol-Zorah; western boundary the Mediterranean; northern boundary along the Yarkon (Me-Jarkon).

properties.name: Half-Manasseh (East)
properties.note: All of Bashan and half-Gilead north of Gad. Anchor cities: Ashtaroth, Edrei, Salecah; northern reach to Mount Hermon. The 'sixty cities of Jair' (Bashan villages) lie on the plateau between the Yarmuk and Hermon.
